summary: Three stranded motorists in the Miners Gulch area of Gilpin County
notes: ART mission 2023-118. Scripps Denver7 (opened run 615): Massachusetts family in Toyota Tacoma stuck in deep snow in Miners Gulch on Christmas Day; iPhone satellite SOS reached Gilpin County SO, which called CO4x4RnR ~6:30 p.m.; ~3-hour nighttime extraction; one party showing altitude-sickness symptoms; all extracted to safety, doing well on departure.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (Gilpin County, Colorado, United States)
